basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate (Mathematics) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Mathematics & Computing group of the Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines), Dhanbad is filling 1 Research Associate (RA) post in a DST-SERB sponsored project at a fellowship of Rs.58000/- per month plus HRA as per norms if accommodation is not provided by the institute. A PhD in Mathematics or an allied branch, or an M.E. / M.Tech in Mathematics or its related disciplines, with at least 60% marks is required. Applications go by email with the CV in the given format and must be received by 17 November 2026.

age_limit.details: Not more than 35 Years. SC/ST/OBC/Women/PD candidates get age relaxation as per DST, Govt. of India norms. The notice does not print a date for counting age. | For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should check the official notification.

qualification.details: PhD in Mathematics / Applied Mathematics / Pure Mathematics / Mathematics and scientific computation or equivalent degrees with at least 60% marks (or a CGPA of 6.5 in 10 point scale); OR M.E. / M.Tech degrees with at least 60% marks (or a CGPA of 6.5 in 10 point scale) in Mathematics or its related disciplines.

how_to_apply: Prepare the detailed resume (CV) in the given format. The application form is on pages 2 and 3 of the notice.
Affix a recent passport size photograph on the form and attach an attested copy of the GATE/NET/Equivalent certificate, if held.
Send the application by e-mail to Prof. Ranjit Kumar Upadhyay at [email protected].
Write the subject as “Application for RA under SERB (CRG)”.
Make sure the application is received by 17 November 2026. Incomplete applications will not be accepted.

The application form asks for name, gender, father/spouse's name, mother's name, communication and permanent address, email id, phone number, date of birth, marital status, nationality, caste category (OP/SC/ST/OBC/PH), details of institutions attended from 10th standard to PhD, qualifying examinations (GATE/NET/Equivalent), professional experience (teaching/research/industrial) if any, any other relevant information and a declaration with signature.
Detailed resume (CV) in the given format
Recent passport size photograph on the application form
Attested copy of GATE/NET/Equivalent certificate, to be attached
Self-attested copies of certificates and mark sheets/grade cards, to be presented at the time of interview
Original documents of age proof, certificates, degrees, mark sheets and other testimonials, to be presented at the time of interview
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and/or joining of the position. All terms and conditions for this recruitment will be as per the guidelines of SERB, DST, Govt. of India and IIT (ISM), Dhanbad. The institute reserves the right to cancel the recruitment without assigning any reason. Original documents must be presented at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate posts are vacant at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: There is 01 Research Associate (RA) post in the DST-SERB sponsored Mathematics project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications is 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the RA post?
faq.answer: A PhD in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Pure Mathematics, Mathematics and scientific computation or equivalent degrees with at least 60% marks (or CGPA 6.5 on a 10 point scale), or M.E. / M.Tech with at least 60% marks (or CGPA 6.5) in Mathematics or its related disciplines. Qualified NET/GATE/equivalent is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 35 Years. SC/ST/OBC/Women/PD candidates get relaxation as per DST, Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs.58000 fellowship?
faq.answer: HRA is payable as per norms if accommodation is not provided by the institute. The notice prints no HRA amount.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the detailed CV in the given format by e-mail to Prof. Ranjit Kumar Upadhyay at [email protected] with the subject “Application for RA under SERB (CRG)”.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview and intimated by e-mail, with the interview date also informed by e-mail.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The assignment is purely temporary in nature and co-terminus with the project, for 01 Years or completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and/or joining of the position.
